observations: No Chengfeng host, account, login, cookie, signed URL, request, response, browser profile, or platform write was used.
No cloud OCR request or paid OCR service was used.
No production or legacy ticket image was used; both smoke images were generated from the frozen synthetic fixture.
No legacy project script, runtime, model, database, process, port, browser profile, cache, or application-data directory was executed, attached to, stopped, reused, or modified.
No Windows DNS, proxy, VPN, routing, hosts file, global browser setting, or GPU driver was changed.
Every repository Python command used the project .venv. CPU OCR and GPU OCR were installed only into their separate generation directories.
The main application environment contains no Paddle, PaddleOCR, PaddleX, or OpenCV distribution.
Normal OCR workers deny Python socket creation and DNS resolution, require exact pre-provisioned model files, and disable silent device fallback and model-source checks.
The worker protocol carries image SHA-256 and a data-root-relative path. It does not carry image bytes, credentials, expected platform weight, or platform candidates.
Static scans found no developer path, gpu:0 identity, Edge executable path, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES assignment, or expected platform weight in the Loop 6 runtime surface.
A technical OCR or infrastructure failure remains a system failure or an explicit CPU fallback and is never converted into a finance-review business item.
The real bootstrap reused the existing verified local model cache and did not request model provisioning.
package_install_network_observation: The dependency installer was not network-instrumented. Its output showed cached artifacts, but this evidence does not claim that package indexes were never consulted. No business data or OCR content was sent by the installer.
environment_limit: Two full-suite tests and one focused Loop 6 test were skipped because this Windows account lacks symbolic-link creation privilege. Fail-closed link and reparse handling is also covered by non-privileged tests.
